c: The Lycaeum is a stage in Vampire Survivors. It is unlocked by collecting 50
Myths are murmured of a school submerged beneath a sunlit lake. In silent depths strange fish survive, while at its peak vile evil thrives.

The Lycaeum is a finite, underwater-themed stage. The bottom section interior of the stage contains bookshelves scattered about as obstacles. Enemies in this section only spawn from the east and west ends of the player's screen. Below the stage exists a large, open area that constantly spawns

c.a: A sprite icon representing Moongolow Atlanteans linking to Moongolow Atlanteans

c: Moongolow Atlanteans. Light sources spawn alongside the walls in the form of blue braziers. There are three red buttons in the center, and both edges of the stage, that spawn a Giant Enemy Crab when pressed. Defeating this boss will cause it to drop an
. There is a large, vertical section in the center of the map.
Once the player enters the vertical section,
The Drowner will appear and can only be defeated with normal damage or by reaching the top of the stage. Every other floor contains a coffin that, once opened, drops either a
Treasure Chest or one of the
's stage items. Treasure Chests spawned this way can only be collected with
Lavatrix Machina. There are 10 coffins on the left side of this section, then followed by 5 buttons that summon

Itchiocentaurs, then followed by 10 coffins on the right side. As the player ascends this section, the music becomes more intense and the background slowly rises, revealing a ruined city on the surface.
Big Troubler resides at the top of the stage, offering the
and, after the respective secret has been completed, the
180,000, respectively. Reaching the top of the stage also enables teleporters that allow the player to instantly reach halfway to the top, or the top, of this section.

Out of bounds, the stage is surrounded by an impenetrable, black border. Approaching the east, south, and west sides of this border causes the screen to gradually get darker as the player gets closer. Approaching the east and west sides of this border will cause all enemies to be replaced with
Golden Eggs are disabled until the player reaches the top of the stage at least once, and are activated alongside the teleports in the stage.
The hyper mode for this stage is unlocked by default after unlocking the stage.
Hyper mode in The Lycaeum has +50% Gold, +10%
